about: Hand-entered same-point baselines for the official early vote by party registration, from dated official reports and news reports that quoted them. Counts are returned ballots (m='ret': mail only; 'voted': mail plus in-person early). Where only shares or a lead were reported, 'gap' (D minus R as a percent of all ballots) is given directly and counts are derived or left out. Machine-built points (Colorado's releases, Florida's archive, UF Election Lab finals) are in pipeline/static/ev_baselines.json.

notes.PA: No in-person early voting, so this is mail ballots returned. Pennsylvania's mail electorate is heavily Democratic whatever the year (about D+53 at 12 days out in 2022, when Republicans won the national House vote by 3), so it says little about direction; the slope fitted for mail-only states is small for that reason. Requests by party are shown for context.
notes.FL: Mail plus in-person. In-person early voting opens Oct 19 (Oct 24 in 2022, Oct 21 in 2024); until then this is mail only, and Florida Republicans moved toward mail after 2022. Florida's final early vote was R+6 in 2022 (result R+19) and R+9 in 2024 (result R+13).
notes.NV: Mail plus in-person, from the Secretary of State's daily files (UF Election Lab compiles them; Jon Ralston's blog reported the 2022 and 2024 leads used here). In-person opens Oct 17. 2022's early vote finished about D+1.5 and the Senate race was D+0.8; 2024's finished R+3.8 and the presidential race was R+3.1.
notes.CO: All-mail state; nearly every ballot is returned by mail or drop box. The Secretary of State posts a release each weekday from about three weeks out with returns by party; 2022 and 2024 points come from those spreadsheets.
notes.IA: Absentee ballots received, which in Iowa include ballots cast in person at the auditor's office. Iowa Democrats vote absentee far more than Republicans in every year (2022's absentee pool was D+19 while the Senate race was R+12), so the small mail-state slope applies. 2022 and 2024 points are the Secretary of State's daily reports as compiled by Bleeding Heartland.
notes.AZ: Early ballots returned, compiled from county reports by Stealth Analytics for UF Election Lab (Arizona has no official statewide daily file). No same-point baseline yet; the 2022 and 2024 final early votes are shown for context.
